description: Extract detailed information from college/university recruitment mail sent to prospective students (postcards, letters, admissions mailers)

institution_name.description: Name of the college or university sending the mail

headline.description: Main headline or hook of the mailer

call_to_action.description: Primary action requested, e.g. 'Start Your Application', 'Schedule a Visit'

admission_criteria.description: What the school says it looks for in applicants

financial_aid.description: Financial aid, scholarship, or cost information

campus_engagement.description: Ways to engage with the school before applying

programs_highlighted.description: Specific academic programs, majors, or schools within the university highlighted

rankings_or_awards.description: Any rankings, awards, or accolades mentioned

contact_information.description: How to get in touch or learn more

personalization.description: Signs the mail was personalized to the recipient

key_dates.description: Test dates, event dates, or other deadlines mentioned that aren't application deadlines
